title: Renames the `authorize_with_url` field for Payment Intents to `redirect_to_url`
summary: Renames the authorize_with_url property on the PaymentIntent to redirect_to_url.

migrationNotes.text: Update your code to reference redirect_to_url instead of authorize_with_url when handling URL-based authorization steps in the payment process.
